The exact reciprocal-moment existence threshold measures rare near-incoherence episodes. The two-sided near-critical boundary-layer profile shows matched probability scaling despite a bifurcating attractor, a motivated singular physical regime not captured by typical positive order-parameter moments. This is a substantive synchronization-clock phase classification rather than a relabeling or a single-parameter plug-in.
